title: Mixed Event — KAMIYAMA HIGH FESTIVAL! — Episode1 The School Festival and Me

meta.Episode: Episode1 — The School Festival and Me
meta.Event Outline: It's the day of the Kamiyama High School Festival, which had completely slipped Mizuki's mind. Upon An's invitation, Mizuki decides to check it out and makes several interesting encounters, including one with a familiar face. Together, they reminisce on the last time they met...

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nngh... Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What time is it...? Eight?
Huh, I woke up earlier than usual.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I finished work early last night, and then...
Oh, right... I passed out at my desk.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great, I've got ink stains on my cheek from my notes. What a crummy way to start a new day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Who's calling me this early? Oh, it's An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Hey, Mizuki! How's it going?
Are you coming to school today?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
School?
But it's Saturday, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I knew it... You forgot.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Forgot about what?
Is something going on today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <The School Festival is today!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
I forgot all about it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Haha! Classic Mizuki...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Our class just finished setting up, so I'm just wandering around. You wanna come? There are food stalls and all sorts of other stuff to do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm, I guess I could...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, but...)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Is that the person you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: I was just a little curious about why you dress the way you do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't really want that kind of attention...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I feel bad about disappointing An, but I think I'll pass...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Oh, and lots of students are wearing funky outfits today. A lot of the second years are in costume for their class shows too. It's really cool!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Unless you wear something really crazy, it's gonna be hard to stand out in this crowd.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That's considerate of her, telling me in an indirect way that it's safe for me to come.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't really come up with any excuse not to go now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'll head over then!
Can't wait to see all those costumes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Great! I'm working my stall until noon, so you can find me in our classroom!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Got it. See you soon, and thanks for the invite.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The School Festival, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I haven't been to one since...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yikes, I can't be spacing out now or I'll be late.
I better get ready to go...!
Kamiyama High School - School Festival Day

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There you are, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What are you wearing...?
Is that a new T-shirt?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it's our class uniform for the day!
We designed it together, so we're all wearing one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
There's one for you too.
Want me to go get it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, I'm good...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There are too many people around to find a private place to get changed anyways...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
Well, it's your choice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I just finished up so let's check out the festival!
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow, this place is packed!
And there are lots of stalls like you said!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! Our School Festival attracts a lot of the local residents too, see?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Look, they're selling cotton candy over there.
It looks so cute! Let's get some!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Phew! That was a lot of stalls.
I feel like I'm gonna pop.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Same here.
Wanna go back to the classroom?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hey, An...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, you made it! You said you weren't sure if you could come, so I'd almost given up hope!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know if I'd have time, but I finished up earlier than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you must be Azusawa.
An's always talking about you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right, she's my unbeatable singing partner♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
H-Hello there!
I'm Kohane Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm Mizuki Akiyama.
It's really nice to meet you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um. Nice to meet you too...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, how about we check stuff out all together?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A-All of us...?!
Oh... Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is she getting nervous because I'm here?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She came all this way on her own, so she probably wants to hang out with An.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, drat! The teacher noticed me. Ever since I missed that test, she's been all over me about taking a make-up...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You two go on ahead. I need to find some place to hide. I'll see you later, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what? Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shoot, they're gone...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like they're not following me.
I might as well look around on my own then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Every class seems to be showcasing something different. There are theater performances, movie-inspired shows... What should I see first?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Although...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Everyone's wearing their class festival T-shirt.
I'm gonna stick out like a sore thumb...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not like that's different from any other day...
Ha ha ha ha ha!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What the...?!
Was someone laughing?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It sounded like it was coming from the empty classroom upstairs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess I don't have anything better to do. Let's go see what's going on...
